Decisive native diagnosis and repair prototype, 2026-09-09 23:29 UTC. Full report /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/docs/verification/javafx-cortical-appearance.md; source/commands/logs/classes/84 hidden native cases/images/hash manifest under output/brain-display/compositing-18 in that repo. No native provider source edited or production OpenJFX override adopted.

There are THREE separable defects. Automatic mipmaps mix unrelated face tiles (prior independent ramp proof). MSAA ordinary oTexCoords interpolation can extrapolate beyond a covered triangle and its tight atlas tile: no mipmaps + no MSAA gives beta same-plan interior mean max-channel error 0.166561; no mipmaps + MSAA gives 4.761105. Exact JavaFX 24.0.1 ES2 diagnostic adds matching centroid varying vec2 oTexCoords declarations and GLSL version 120; no-mipmap + centroid + MSAA gives 1.114809 (point-sampled CPU and MSAA coverage differ). Version-120-only GPU crop is byte-identical to prior no-mipmap shader. Independent public-JavaFX shuffled horizontal ramp with MSAA and mipmaps off: at 8,192/32,768/131,072 faces ordinary RMS 4.082406/11.020931/35.641010, centroid RMS 0.329018/0.410830/0.391206; maximum column variation collapses to 1. Real beta and FIR each pass 12 hidden centroid cases; actual reviewed texture is clean. Material/shader class origins and immutable runtime inputs asserted. macOS ES2 only, no cross-platform adoption claim.

User supplied an additional affine-encoding diagnosis, now independently confirmed in our exact pinned JavaFxFaceAtlas.writeTile source (SHA256 65376313962a4d3c4aa4b0bee3c0528246c0cd0c33239591917b283a433c954a): renormalizing outside-triangle weights makes the 4x4 tile non-affine. Opaque gray vertices (0,255,255) give 233.75 instead of 255 at the BC midpoint; inside s=t=.48 gives 228.344 instead of 244.8. Cyclic face/color/barycentric order changes this physical point to 244.8. This is an encoding defect independently of mipmaps/MSAA, not a quantified attribution of the whole cortical residual.

The proposed four-midpoint-child 2x2 atlas encoding is affine-safe: fourth texel d=q+r-p is always an original color or midpoint, thus no clipping required. Separate CPU oracle with 5,000 RGB triangles, four children and 120 sample points including edges gives 7.2 million channel samples, prequantization max error 8.53e-14, rounded max 0.5, RMS 0.223949. Native implementation still outstanding. Fourfold geometry means 549,018 -> 2,196,072 rendered faces in current bilateral fixture, while nominal pixels remain 16 per original face.

Next native implementation must preserve the original already-composited RGB interpolation contract (no nonlinear remapping at scalar midpoints), child-to-original face/barycentric/vertex provenance, morph updates and resource admission. Implement adapter-local encoding policy; test edge bands and interiors, saturated colors, cyclic and atlas permutations, distance/obliquity/device scale, then lighting and dense-scene update latency/memory. Maintain explicit mipmap/centroid runtime capability: the current diagnostic class overrides are process-wide, not a production packaging decision. Public PhongMaterial has no per-texture control. No mesh4s bug established. Keep this issue open through implementation and required provider/consumer qualification.
